reasons.correctness: SupportTicket gets `@Version private Long version`. A changeset adds `version BIGINT DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL` with a rollback and is included in changelog.xml. Build is green and hidden tests pass 2/2.
reasons.convention_fit: The changeset path, name, header, rollback and dated include comment follow the Liquibase convention. The @Version field matches the locking rule. The only gap is that no new *UnitTest class was created; tests were appended to the existing SupportTicketEntityUnitTest.
reasons.design_fit: The change is minimal: one entity field, one new changeset, one include line. It follows the existing add-version-to-applied-opportunity changeset. There is no new mechanism and no unrelated edits.
reasons.test_quality: The added VersionTests only check that the field starts null and that a getter/setter round-trip works. Nothing tests concurrent modification or conflict behaviour, and there is no new MockitoExtension test class.
reasons.graph_use: Graph queries found the support/ticket files and changelog paths early. The locking example and the changelog tail were then found with grep, tail and file reads, so text search did most of the navigation.
